spans.s: ? ṛdhyati, perhaps in transitive sense (so Vedic, not Class. Skt.), makes perfect, makes successful: LV 〔178.10〕 (vs) (svargāmṛtadvāra muñcahī) ṛddhyahi (so Lefm., em.; mss. ṛddhyabhi-, ṛddho bhi-, ṛddhyehi, ṛddhyebhiḥ; Calc. ṛddhi hi, Foucaux ṛddhihi as impv.) śīlavato cintitaṃ. Tib. is confused in order but if I understand correctly it reads for this phrase: tshul khrims ldan paḥi bsam pa ḥgrub ḥgyur gyis, which seems to support an impv.: make to become accomplished the thought of (the) one endowed with morality.
